scope_rationale: The generic specialized-algorithm leaf did not supply the corpus error-correction mechanism. This required five-competency refinement adds full representations, bounds and counterexamples, not an optional heading; accepted IDs/hours remain unchanged.

competencies.title: Representation, parity derivation and code distance
competencies.outcome: Derive check positions, injectivity, minimum distance4 and both payload widths.

competencies.title: Bounded decoder and failure publication
competencies.outcome: Correct every admitted single flip, detect double flips, preserve refusal output and reject unsupported bounds.

competencies.title: Erasure recovery and independent nearest-codeword oracle
competencies.outcome: Derive2t+s<4, construct the enumerative recovery, compare independent codebooks and explain finite coverage.

competencies.title: Burst interleaving, phase and costs
competencies.outcome: Implement four-lane and rotating-phase maps, derive burst bounds and compare rate/work/buffering under equal guarantees.

competencies.title: Higher-error and attacker counterexamples
competencies.outcome: Demonstrate miscorrection, valid-word forgery and wrong-phase identity; separate noise correction from authenticity and real channel behavior.
